description: Comptages vélos is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Toulouse Métropole. Les comptages vélos sont réalisés un jour de semaine (Mardi ou jeudi) et un samedi, en général entre septembre et octobre sur les tranches horaires: 07h00 - 09h00 et 17h00 - 19h00 semaine 15h00 - 17h00 samedi Attention, compte tenu de la courte période d'enquête la météo joue un rôle prépondérant sur les résultats. Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are comptage, vélo, trafic. The portal shows 124 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-10-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
